rules.title: Standard recipes
rules.text: Provide fmt, lint and test recipes as the standard entry points for contributors and agents.

rules.title: Discoverable recipes
rules.text: Keep recipe names short and make them discoverable with just --list.

rules.title: Document each recipe
rules.text: Add a doc line above each recipe so just --list explains it.

rules.title: Parameters with defaults
rules.text: Use recipe parameters with defaults instead of environment variable juggling.

rules.title: Format changed files
rules.text: Offer a recipe that formats only files changed since HEAD.

rules.title: Short aliases
rules.text: Define short aliases such as b, t and f for the most common recipes.

rules.title: Scaffold recipes
rules.text: Provide scaffold recipes for new tests and benchmarks so they start from the repo template.

rules.title: Hooks match CI
rules.text: Wire the pre-commit hook to the same recipes CI runs.
